item.title: [7.3] Japan’s 10-year bond yield hits three-decade high
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Japan’s 10-year government bond yield climbed to its highest level since 1996, driven by rising global bond yields, renewed inflation concerns and growing expectations of a Bank of Japan rate hike as early as September. The move highlights increasing pressure on Japan’s bond market as investors reassess the outlook for monetary policy.

WHY IT MATTERS

A 30-year high in Japanese bond yields marks a structural shift away from decades of ultra-loose monetary policy with global macro implications.
